commands.name: dev-studio
commands.description: Studio v2 umbrella router. Dispatches by canonical role from any project: manager, worker, reviewer, perf, planner, qa-engineer, flow-tester, release-manager.

commands.name: fullSendToAppStore
commands.description: Tag current commit, draft GitHub release, and submit build to App Store review

commands.name: postSlackTesting
commands.description: Post an iOS TestFlight build notification to the configured Slack channel

commands.name: pushTFBuild
commands.description: Bump build number/version, archive, and push to TestFlight via App Store Connect

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Retrospectively scan the current session for idea-worthy content and update IDEAS.md with dedup

commands.name: resume-plan
commands.description: Resume the architecture refactor — read roadmap + memory, report current state, ask pending questions

commands.name: studio-setup
commands.description: Onboard the current machine via scripts/bootstrap.sh. Auto-pilot by default — only prompts for role if not given. Flags: --manager, --worker, --dual, --interactive, --dry-run, --help.
